segmentation.text: When overtaking or passing
a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
proceeding in the same direction,
the driver of a motor vehicle
shall exercise due care and:
If there is only one lane for traffic proceeding in the same direction,
pass to the left of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter
at a safe distance, which must be not less than 3 feet between any portion of the vehicle and the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter,
and shall not move again to the right side of the highway
until the vehicle is safely clear of the overtaken bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.
Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.213 and 484B.217 [NRS-484B-213-1, NRS-484B-213-2a, NRS-484B-213-2b, NRS-484B-213-2c, NRS-484B-217-2],

when passing to the left of a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter at a safe distance of not less than 3 feet between any portion of the vehicle and the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter, this paragraph authorizes the driver, if it is safe, to pass: (1) To the left of the center of the highway. (2) In a no-passing zone.

elements.justification: 'overtaking or passing' a road user proceeding the same way is drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, r): 'a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it'; it denotes the relative motion only. The pass is under way while the bodies are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero; a projection, not a contact or a distance), within the window behind the pass's recognition.

'a bicycle' is DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle ('a device propelled by human power upon which a person may ride'), 'an electric bicycle' DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle, 'an electric scooter' DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter ('a vehicle with handlebars and an electric motor that is designed to be ridden on'); each admitted aggregate claimed whole, as the index maps 'a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter'.

'proceeding' is the overtaken road user moving (kin.speed above the halt tolerance); 'in the same direction' is rel.same_direction ('headings aligned') between the subject and it, as the index maps 'proceeding in the same direction,'.
'a motor vehicle' is DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails'). 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: the pass is made with due care where the subject's body never touches the overtaken rider's (rel.contact) and the rider is never made to brake harder than an evasive deceleration (kin.accel_longitudinal below its negative) while the two are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero); care is a state of mind, read only through this outcome

residues.why: the authorization lets a driver passing a rider at the stated clearance pass left of the center or in a no-passing zone, conduct other rules (NRS 484B.213, 484B.217) forbid; it relaxes those rules and leaves the duties of this paragraph unchanged: the duty of care is the same whether or not the authorization holds

applicability: The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle. At the observation, drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, r) rises, with window p.overtake_window and same_dir_cos p.overtake_same_direction_cos, for some road user r, not the subject, a member of DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle, DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle or DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter, which at some observation of the window behind of length p.overtake_window was moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) with its heading aligned with the subject's (rel.same_direction, p.overtake_same_direction_cos). The authorization (b12), suspended where NRS_484B_213_1, NRS_484B_213_2a, NRS_484B_213_2b, NRS_484B_213_2c or NRS_484B_217_2 applies, does not change this duty.
obligation: Surrogate. For every such r (re-bound with its whole selection): at every observation of the window behind of length p.overtake_window, the subject is not in contact with r (rel.contact), and wherever the two are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero) r's longitudinal acceleration (kin.accel_longitudinal) is not below the negative of p.rider_evasive_decel.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of a motor vehicle is read through the vehicle's controlled motion
'due care' is read only through the pass's outcome for the rider: no contact and no evasive braking while side by side; the rule is a surrogate

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: On a road with one lane in the subject's direction, a bicycle is ridden ahead of the subject car; the subject car overtakes it and its mirror touches the bicyclist while side by side.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same pass, made without contact; the bicyclist keeps its speed.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject car overtakes another car; no bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is in the scene. The duty binds the subject alone.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in permit, but the source does not observe contact between bodies.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject car overtakes an electric bicycle without touching it, but while they are side by side the rider brakes harder than the evasive deceleration.

elements.justification: 'overtaking or passing' a road user proceeding the same way is drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, r): 'a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it'; it denotes the relative motion only, the side being read by b7. The pass is under way while the bodies are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero; a projection, not a contact or a distance), within the window behind the pass's recognition.

'a bicycle' is DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle ('a device propelled by human power upon which a person may ride'), 'an electric bicycle' DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle, 'an electric scooter' DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter ('a vehicle with handlebars and an electric motor that is designed to be ridden on'); each admitted aggregate claimed whole.
'proceeding' is the overtaken road user moving (kin.speed above the halt tolerance); 'in the same direction' is rel.same_direction ('headings aligned') between the subject and it.
'a motor vehicle' is DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails'). 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

'only one lane for traffic proceeding in the same direction' is the count of lanes in the direction of a lane (st.lane) the overtaken rider occupies (rel.occupies) being the stated one (st.lane_adjacency, 'the count of lanes in that direction'; not the marking between lanes). 'traffic' names the users of the lane; no membership is read.

'pass to the left of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter' (the overtaken road user of b2, its aggregates claimed again for these words): at every observation of the pass at which the two are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), the rider lies on the subject's right: the lateral component of its bearing in the subject's frame (rel.bearing, 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for "on the right of" ...)') is negative.

operationalizations.standard: at a safe distance, which must be not less than 3 feet between any portion of the vehicle and the bicycle
operationalizations.convention: lateral passing clearance: the distance between the nearest points of the two bodies (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies', which is the distance between any portion of the vehicle and the rider's device) is at least the larger of the stated 3 feet and the bicyclist operating-space clearance the reading sets, at every observation at which the two are side by side

residues.why: the authorization lets a driver passing a rider at the stated clearance pass left of the center or in a no-passing zone, conduct other rules (NRS 484B.213, 484B.217) forbid; it relaxes those rules and leaves the duty to pass on the left at a safe distance unchanged

applicability: The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle. At the observation, drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, r) rises, with window p.overtake_window and same_dir_cos p.overtake_same_direction_cos, for some road user r, not the subject, a member of DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle, DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle or DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter, which at some observation of that window was moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) with its heading aligned with the subject's (rel.same_direction, p.overtake_same_direction_cos); and at some observation of that window at which the two were side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), r occupied a st.lane whose count of lanes in its direction (st.lane_adjacency count) is the literal one.
obligation: For every such r (re-bound with its whole selection): at every observation of the window behind of length p.overtake_window at which the subject and r are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), r lies on the subject's right (rel.bearing from the subject, lateral component negative) and the gap between their bodies (rel.surface_gap) is at least the larger of the literal 3 ft and p.bicycle_pass_safe_gap.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of a motor vehicle is read through the vehicle's controlled motion
'a safe distance' is read as one lateral clearance the reading sets, never below the stated 3 feet; the clearance does not grow with the subject's speed

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Road with one lane in the subject's direction; a bicycle rides in it. The subject car overtakes the bicycle on its left with a body-to-body gap below 3 feet while side by side.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same pass, the subject car keeping a gap above both 3 feet and the safe-gap clearance while side by side, the bicycle on its right.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject car overtakes another car on a one-lane road; no bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is in the scene. The duty binds the subject alone.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source does not observe the gap between bodies.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject car overtakes an electric scooter on the scooter's right, with a wide gap: while side by side the scooter lies on the subject's left.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The road has two lanes in the subject's direction; the subject passes a bicycle.

at a safe distance, which must be not less than 3 feet between any portion of the vehicle and the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter,
and shall not move again to the right side of the highway
until the vehicle is safely clear of the overtaken bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.

Here the pass is read while under way - the bodies side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero; a projection, not a contact or a distance) after the rider was ahead within the window - and once completed, from the observation at which the concept rises, within the window.

'a bicycle' is DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle ('a device propelled by human power upon which a person may ride'), 'an electric bicycle' DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle, 'an electric scooter' DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter ('a vehicle with handlebars and an electric motor that is designed to be ridden on'); each admitted aggregate claimed whole.
'proceeding' is the overtaken road user moving (kin.speed above the halt tolerance); 'in the same direction' is rel.same_direction ('headings aligned') between the subject and it.
'a motor vehicle' is DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails'). 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

'only one lane for traffic proceeding in the same direction' is the count of lanes in the direction of a lane (st.lane) the overtaken rider occupies (rel.occupies) being the stated one (st.lane_adjacency, 'the count of lanes in that direction'). 'traffic' names the users of the lane; no membership is read.

'move again to the right side of the highway': having moved out to the left of the rider (rel.bearing from the subject, lateral component negative: the rider on its right), the subject turns back toward the side the rider keeps: drv.lane.heading_right_of_carrier(subject, L) for a lane L (st.lane) the rider occupies (rel.occupies) - 'a, moving, points to the right of the designated direction of travel of carrier region r by more than a tolerance'. The concept says nothing of whether the subject occupies L, so it reads a move back toward the rider's lane from the opposing lane or from the left part of the rider's lane alike. 'again' fixes the order: the subject first had the rider on its right.

operationalizations.standard: until the vehicle is safely clear of the overtaken bicycle
operationalizations.convention: time headway: the subject (the vehicle) is safely clear of the overtaken rider where the rider is behind it (rel.bearing longitudinal component negative, rel.longitudinal_overlap negative) with a gap between the bodies (rel.surface_gap) of at least the rider's speed times the following headway for the surface - ice or snow, else wet road or precipitation, else dry - so that the rider, following, keeps the headway a following road user keeps

residues.why: the authorization lets a driver passing a rider at the stated clearance pass left of the center or in a no-passing zone, conduct other rules (NRS 484B.213, 484B.217) forbid; it relaxes those rules and leaves the duty not to move back right before being clear unchanged

applicability: The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle. Some road user r, not the subject, a member of DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle, DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle or DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter, moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) with its heading aligned with the subject's (rel.same_direction, p.overtake_same_direction_cos), is being overtaken by the subject: at some observation of the window behind of length p.overtake_window r was ahead of the subject (rel.bearing longitudinal component positive, rel.longitudinal_overlap negative) with aligned headings, and either r is not yet behind the subject or drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, r) (window p.overtake_window, same_dir_cos p.overtake_same_direction_cos) has risen at some observation of that window; r lies on the subject's right (rel.bearing lateral component negative); and r occupies a st.lane whose count of lanes in its direction (st.lane_adjacency count) is the literal one.
obligation: For every such r (re-bound with its whole selection), where r is not safely clear behind the subject - that is, not (r behind the subject, rel.bearing longitudinal component negative and rel.longitudinal_overlap negative, with rel.surface_gap at least r's kin.speed times the headway: p.following_headway_ice where env.ice_or_snow holds, else p.following_headway_wet where env.wet_road or env.precipitation holds, else p.following_headway_dry) - the subject does not move to the right: drv.lane.heading_right_of_carrier(subject, L) with sin_tol p.course_departure_sin_tol and speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance holds for no st.lane L that r occupies (rel.occupies).

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of a motor vehicle is read through the vehicle's controlled motion

'move again to the right side of the highway' is read as the subject's heading turned to the right of the rider's lane direction beyond the course tolerance, after it has the rider on its right; a gradual drift within that tolerance is not read
'safely clear' is read as the rider behind the subject at a time-headway gap at the rider's speed; the rider's own braking ability is not otherwise read

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Road with one lane in the subject's direction; the subject car moves out left and overtakes a bicycle; while the bicycle is still beside it, the subject car steers back to the right, its heading turning right of the lane's direction beyond the course tolerance.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same pass; the subject car keeps its course until the bicycle is behind it at a gap above the bicycle's speed times the dry headway, then steers back right.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject car overtakes another car on a one-lane road and steers back; no bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is in the scene. The duty binds the subject alone.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source does not observe headings.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject car completes the pass of an electric scooter and steers back right at once, the scooter behind it at a gap below its speed times the dry headway.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The road has two lanes in the subject's direction; the subject passes a bicycle and steers back right while beside it.
